entries.title: Choose when long conversations get summarized
entries.body: Settings → Intelligence has a new choice for when your first mate and crew summarize a long conversation: Automatic, 150,000, 200,000, 300,000 or 500,000 tokens, or each model's own limit. Automatic keeps today's rule. When the number you pick lets a model run past a point where its requests cost more, the row names that model.

picture.alt: Settings row Summarize long conversations at, set to 300,000 tokens, noting that GPT-6.1 Sol requests cost more past 272,000
